integrity: Analytical proof and finite exact checks support the described claim; external independent mathematical audit is not performed.
scientific_limitations: Two complete SGD epochs started at the same scalar input, equal positive component curvature, contraction strictly between zero and one, nonidentical centers; position relabeling fixed independently of data and sampled permutation. No assertion of general coupling optimality, arbitrary nonlinear problems, or cost-adjusted improvement.
title: Unique reverse-pair variance minimizer and sharp epoch-scale crossover for equal-curvature reshuffling
